Crafted tactile editorial miniature about three early pension withdrawal rounds, not actual flow quantities. Whole jar, all taps and bowls visible with generous margin.

framing_edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Zoom OUT the scene about 30 percent to restore all object edges cut by this crop. Final composition must show ALL principal objects completely, with at least 20 percent empty margin above and below, so a centered 1200x630 crop loses none of them. Maintain premium tactile MEE cobalt, vermilion and warm ivory palette, lighting and textures. No text, numbers, labels, logos or watermark. Do not change object count or invent additional objects.
